A Rift-touched leviathan from a drowned world that fell through the Rift into the Severed Lands' deepest waters. The kraken is not merely a creature — it carries an entire ecosystem of Rift-touched marine life in its wake. Fisherfolk whisper that its eye shines with the light of its dead world's last sunrise.
## Traits
**Amphibious.** Breathes air and water.
**Freedom of Movement.** Ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce speed or cause restrained/paralyzed.
**Siege Monster.** Double damage to objects and structures.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Bite + two tentacles, or three tentacles + Fling.
**Bite.** +18 to hit, 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing. If Large or smaller, swallowed: blinded, restrained, 42 (12d6) acid at start of each rift kraken turn.
**Tentacle.** +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning. Grappled (escape DC 20).
**Fling.** Large or smaller creatures grappled are thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If striking a solid surface, target takes 1d6 bludgeoning per 10 feet thrown.
**Lightning Storm.** Magically creates three bolts of lightning, each striking a point the rift kraken can see within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet must make DC 23 DEX save, taking 22 (4d10) lightning (half on success). Recharges 5-6.
